basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old graduate student living in Gainesville, Florida. I love running, especially around Depot Park, and exploring new tech trends. I have a knack for cryptocurrencies and frequently delve into discussions about Kadena and WirexApp. During my downtime, I enjoy gaming, particularly in the NBA 2K community. I'm currently single and split my time between studying and working part-time as a barista. My typical online hours are late evenings, usually after 9 PM, when I unwind after a long day.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and am pursuing my Master's in the same field. My interest in cryptocurrencies started in college, where I joined a blockchain club. I've gained practical knowledge by participating in online forums and investing small amounts to understand market trends better.
